rule: Latest available author release per Minecraft/loader branch; parity never inferred from version/hash. Update gaps and canonical adapters before claiming latest gameplay.

branches.source_scope: Current author 1.2.0; reviewed Forge main c4ec1880. T132 retains T131 offhand shaker transactions, original use ordering, furniture/board/trellis operations, selected animated items and source-backed sound/fire fixes. T132 adds shared instantaneous splash dispatch, potion admission, station hand/echo retry, native storage rollback, query-first fish/living selection and four guide UI flipbooks. See docs/RELEASE-NOTES-0.6.132.md and docs/PARITY-MATRIX.md for exact scopes. Arbitrary three-stack metadata, native event phases, outlines/camera/effects and rendered client/input/audio parity remain incomplete. The separate unreleased26.1.2 source9b8f165a is only partially reviewed; not a published release reference. T134 retains T132 and reviewed T133 coordinate-axis equality, restores counted complete native machine ingredients and bounded portable stackable metadata, original container/extraction/mode handling, owned status particles, one-tick grass lease and explicit tipsy yaw opt-in, board outlines, animated ice grapes and source-shaded arbitrary RGB. Native first/restart evidence belongs to the exact paired T134/W111 CI; complete native Player, renderer/audio, saved private family and LIVE acceptance remain separate and pending. T135 follows actual T134 CI findings: retain all original repairs, add 25 required PBR texture-set companions through existing generators and accept native bare adventure block identifiers without rewriting metadata or relaxing native reconstruction checks. W112 is the exact dependent pair; T134 failures and W111 source/build success remain historical, with new exact CI and client/LIVE evidence separate. T136 preserves this complete T135 implementation and repairs Upside Down alive Mob AABB selection, including familyless native fish and a complete snapshot before naming. Source name-visibility and actual rendered inversion remain unverified. Paired W113 confirms new Nether-anchor metadata; exact candidate CI/native and private/client/LIVE remain separate. T137 preserves T136 source semantics and repairs a measured native restart ownership loss: a real entityLoad may acknowledge exactly one same-tick, unchanged saved native effect notification; generic restoration, changed leases/fences, new writes, foreign refreshes, unload and death cannot retain that witness. This is a source-owned appearance adapter for observed BDS rehydration, not complete native effect-origin or rendered Player equivalence. Paired W114 retains W113 anchor behavior with T137 dependencies. T138 integrates the parallel observed-native-countdown and fresh-persistence repair with the exact T137 entityLoad acknowledgement and lifecycle fences. Source review 71e5c372 remains distinct from the original Java branch authority; no author version or complete client parity is inferred from this runtime adaptation. W115 retains the confirmed anchor behavior, and isolated multiline tools remain pending human acceptance. T140 follows merged canonical T139/W116 and adds the observed invalid-before/entityLoad/same-tick-after proof plus initialSpawn proof retention without reminting, preserving all T139 native-clock, durable-fence, native-only death, Mob and visual behavior. W117 changes only paired identity/dependency. Recorded native sources and all observer/generated overlay inputs must match the frozen candidate; new-candidate CI/native and actual Player/client/private LIVE remain separate.
